Rehabilitation appointments

Planning your trip

Let the team know about walking aids, boarding needs and changes in mobility. Transportation supports getting to appointments; therapy and treatment remain with your healthcare professionals.

Can transportation be arranged for repeated therapy visits?

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For travel to physical therapy, rehabilitation and other scheduled recovery appointments.

How the journey is planned

Recovery needs can change between appointments. Tell the team what walking aids or wheelchair arrangements are needed now, rather than relying on a previous trip’s details. Include the therapy location, arrival time and return estimate. Transportation helps you reach treatment; exercise instructions and clinical decisions remain with the treating professionals.

What we plan with you

  • Planning around therapy appointments
  • Review of current mobility and access needs
  • Requests for repeated visits and returns

Have these details ready

  • Therapy dates, location and arrival times
  • Current walking aid or wheelchair needs
  • Changes in boarding ability or assistance

Questions about this service

Can I request transport for a course of therapy?

Yes. Provide the dates and expected appointment times so the team can review the full transportation request.

Does the driver provide rehabilitation treatment?

This is a transportation service. Therapy, transfers requiring clinical support and treatment instructions must be handled by the appropriate healthcare professionals.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Sources for general planning guidance
  • Mobility Transportation Services: patient FAQs
  • Call The Care: Fort Worth transportation

Details to have ready

  • Therapy dates and required arrival times
  • Walking aids or wheelchair requirements
  • Return arrangements and access needs

How to arrange a ride

Choose rehabilitation appointments and prepare the trip details. The transportation team must review your request, vehicle suitability and availability before confirming pickup. A calendar appointment or prepared request alone does not confirm transportation.
